item.title: OBU women cruise by Southern Arkansas 82-57
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist put together one of its most complete performances of the season on Thursday night, cruising to an 82–57 Great American Conference victory over Southern Arkansas inside the Noble Complex.

item.title: OBU approved to offer fully online 90-credit Bachelor of Applied Science in Business Administration
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist University has received formal approval from the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) to offer a 90-credit-hour Bachelor of Applied Science in Business Administration; a fully online program designed for working professionals and adult learners. The approval authorizes OBU to deliver the degree in a reduced-credit format.

item.title: 2018 half-cent sales tax continues to execute city of Shawnee improvements
item.description: Looking at the fourth quarter of 2025, Assistant City Manager Seth Barkhimer offered the quarterly report on the half-cent sales tax at the January Shawnee City Commission meeting.

item.title: Mabee-Gerrer Museum of Art to host Gallery Talk on Feb. 6
item.description: (SHAWNEE, Okla.) – Delaynna Trim, MGMoA Curator of Collections will speak on Friday, Feb. 6 about the Madonna and Child: Medieval to Modern exhibit.

item.title: Growing Like a Read helps families build a strong foundation for learning
item.description: Cleveland, McClain, Pottawatomie Counties, OK – Early literacy begins long before a child starts school, and Pioneer Library System (PLS) is here to help every family prepare for success through its Growing Like a Read (GLAR) initiative. Designed for children from birth to age five, the library’s Growing Like a Read program supports the development of six essential pre-reading skills: Phonological Awareness, Letter Knowledge, Narrative Skills, Vocabulary, Print Awareness, and Print Motivation.

item.title: Bison softball squad off to 5-0 start to 2026 season
item.description: MANSFIELD, Texas — Oklahoma Baptist capped a perfect weekend Sunday afternoon with a 5–3 win over St. Edward's at the Fields at Station, finishing the weekend 5–0.
